cause_quote: The new additive-only update branch called `await prepareUpdateAgentAdditiveSchemas(params)`, which went straight to `await withAgentDatabaseMaintenanceLease(...)` without first completing shared-state repair.
user_saw: An upgrade could stop in Doctor while preparing agent databases if the shared SQLite database still lacked a required column.
summary: Doctor now detects unfinished shared-state columns and completes their repair after backups and before acquiring an agent maintenance lease.
reasoning: I compared #184547 with its parent and confirmed that it introduced the early additive-only agent preparation path, with lease acquisition already ahead of shared-state repair. The fix also covers the older version-migration path and repairs gaps in column detection, so the cited commit explains the additive-only upgrade failure while those other cases have separate history.
